hypothesis.failureCondition: Reject at the predeclared ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations meet both entry rules, or if required exact-size quotes are invalid or unavailable. A pass is not acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate. Unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model invoice costs prevent a full-profit claim.
hypothesis.name: CASHCAT round-trip size-curve test
hypothesis.rationale: Measured fact: the verified graph has two WETH–CASHCAT pools, and the menu offers this route as a SIZE_CURVE cell capped at 0.02 WETH. Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: the route may show size-dependent after-gas net behavior. Quote every supplied exact size up to the cap, then select the greatest current after-gas net; do not scale quote outputs. Entry requires the selected quote to meet the 20 bps edge floor and configured gas-safety rule for two consecutive eligible observations. The available evidence does not establish a forward result for this hypothesis.

result.boundary: Ten-observation prospective futility screen followed by longer forward collection for promising ideas. This is not seven-day acceptance. Signals assume known gas only, are not fills or complete profit, and do not authorize a policy change.

hypothesis.name: Four-hop PONS–CASHCAT route size-curve test
hypothesis.rationale: Measured fact: the verified graph contains pools connecting WETH, PONS, USDG, and CASHCAT, and this four-hop route/size/family cell is available in the menu. Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: comparing every supplied exact size up to 0.02 WETH may identify a size at which the current after-gas net meets the entry rules. The runner must select the greatest current after-gas net and must not scale quote outputs. No training row is treated as validation of this forward hypothesis.
